_meta.method: Web research on Dharma Drum Malaysia, Plum Village Malaysia retreats, Soto Zen / Sotoshu directory for Malaysia.
_meta.coverageEstimate: Medium. Malaysia has many Mahayana temples but few that practice zazen/Chan in a sustained way; we list the institutional Chan/Zen ones.
knownGaps: No standing Plum Village monastery in Malaysia; retreats are co-organized with Singapore Sangha and Thai Plum Village.
Bodhiyana retreat reference in source brief not verified to a current organizational URL.
Smaller Sanbo Zen / Rinzai lay groups not located via sourced URLs.

places.name: Dharma Drum Mountain Malaysia Centre
places.address: No. 9, Jalan 51A/225A, Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia
places.notes: Dharma Drum Mountain Malaysia centre. Its activities page lists Friday meditation from 20:30 to 22:00; see https://ddmmy.org/our-activities/ . Lineage and organization details: https://ddmmy.org/about-ddm-malaysia/ .

places.name: Fo Guang Shan Dong Zen Temple
places.address: PT 2297, Jalan Sg. Buaya, Jenjarom, Selangor, Malaysia
places.notes: Fo Guang Shan Dong Zen Temple in Jenjarom. Visitor information: https://www.mpkl.gov.my/pelawat/tarikan-pelancong/fo-guan-shan-don-zen-temple . Broad Humanistic Buddhist institution; no Chan practice schedule is asserted.

places.name: KYCL International Zen Centre
places.lineage: Kwan Um School of Zen (Korean Seon kong-an practice)
places.address: Lot 109, Telok Ramunia, 81620 Pengerang, Johor, Malaysia
places.notes: Kwan Yin Chan Lin international retreat centre in Pengerang. The organization lists a 2026 retreat on its homepage; its teachers page documents the Seung Sahn / Jogye lineage: https://www.kyclzen.sg/our-teachers . Confirm retreat arrangements before visiting.

places.name: KYCL Muar Meditation Centre
places.lineage: Kwan Um School of Zen (Korean Seon kong-an practice)
places.notes: Kwan Yin Chan Lin Muar group. The Malaysia page gives a temporary centre at Persatuan Chiang Chuan, 33 Jalan Ali; a retreat page gives a different Parit Jawa venue (PTD 5343, Jalan Melur, Taman Seroja). Kept at approximate Muar location with no street address because the regular venue is uncertain. Current activities: https://www.kyclzen.sg/2026-calendar .
